## 🎯 Problem Statement

Is this request related to a problem? Please describe.

> _Ex: "I'd like to add a results section for the new benchmark..."_

## 💡 Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## 📖 Proposed Content / Example

If applicable, describe what the new content would look like (new section, new
figure, additional analysis, etc.).

## 🌈 Use Case & Benefits

Why is this important? How does it improve the paper?

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or approaches
you've considered.

## ⚠️ Additional Context

Add any other context, screenshots, or links to similar implementations here.
